limitations: Raw and graph are real authenticated Chat / LLM / saved-history tests. Parsed metadata is a separate direct Mastra HTTP tool test, not LLM tool selection.
Two parsed metadata questions (natural and explicit tool name) did not invoke parsed-doc-fetch; both failed that exploratory assertion and are retained here.
parsed-doc-fetch reads DB metadata, not parsed file bodies. Local parsed artifacts were normalized to the existing schema before the final runs.
Synthetic edge topology is seeded, not generated by a relation-extraction LLM. Raw reads cover one small Web HTML document only.
Single-run observations do not waive existing quality gates. Large-scale load skipped by user request; no production deployment, primary switch, shadow observation or restore.
